soru: Araç kullanan ve hafızası olan büyük dil modeli ajanlarında veri gizliliği tehditleri ve savunmaları üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Araç kullanan ve hafızası olan büyük dil modeli ajanlarında veri gizliliği tehditleri ve savunmaları üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-05-25. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Not what you've signed up for: Compromising Real-World LLM-Integrated Applications with Indirect Prompt Injection
calismalar.gerekce: This paper introduced indirect prompt injection and set out the threat model for data theft and exfiltration from LLM applications that use tools.

calismalar.baslik: Unveiling Privacy Risks in LLM Agent Memory
calismalar.gerekce: MEXTRA is the first systematic black-box attack that extracts private user interactions stored in an agent's memory module.

calismalar.baslik: AirGapAgent: Protecting Privacy-Conscious Conversational Agents
calismalar.gerekce: It applies contextual integrity to agent design, restricting the agent to the data each task needs, and shows this defends against context-hijacking attacks.

calismalar.baslik: PrivacyLens: Evaluating Privacy Norm Awareness of Language Models in Action
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that models which answer privacy questions correctly still leak sensitive information in the actions they take as agents, and it became the standard benchmark for agent privacy.

calismalar.baslik: Can LLMs Keep a Secret? Testing Privacy Implications of Language Models via Contextual Integrity Theory
calismalar.gerekce: The ConfAIde benchmark established contextual integrity as the basis for measuring inference-time contextual privacy in LLMs.

calismalar.baslik: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents
calismalar.gerekce: It is the reference dynamic benchmark for prompt injection attacks and defenses against tool-using agents, including data exfiltration scenarios.

calismalar.baslik: InjecAgent: Benchmarking Indirect Prompt Injections in Tool-Integrated Large Language Model Agents
calismalar.gerekce: It was the first large benchmark to treat private-data exfiltration as an explicit attack goal for tool-integrated agents.

calismalar.baslik: Defeating Prompt Injections by Design
calismalar.gerekce: CaMeL separates control flow from data flow and adds capability-based policies, giving provable guarantees against data exfiltration.

calismalar.baslik: EIA: Environmental Injection Attack on Generalist Web Agents for Privacy Leakage
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that web agents can be made to leak users' PII through elements injected into web pages.

calismalar.baslik: AgentPoison: Red-teaming LLM Agents via Poisoning Memory or Knowledge Bases
calismalar.gerekce: It established the backdoor attack against agents through poisoning of long-term memory or RAG knowledge bases.

calismalar.baslik: Memory Injection Attacks on LLM Agents via Query-Only Interaction (orig. A Practical Memory Injection Attack against LLM Agents)
calismalar.gerekce: MINJA shows that an attacker can poison an agent's memory using only ordinary queries.

calismalar.baslik: Firewalls to Secure Dynamic LLM Agentic Networks
calismalar.gerekce: It proposes firewalls that abstract user data and enforce a structured protocol to protect privacy in agent-to-agent communication.

calismalar.baslik: Operationalizing Contextual Integrity in Privacy-Conscious Assistants
calismalar.gerekce: It makes contextual integrity reasoning operational in assistants that share user data with third parties, such as in form filling.

calismalar.baslik: Securing AI Agents with Information-Flow Control
calismalar.gerekce: The FIDES planner uses confidentiality and integrity labels with deterministic policy checks to provide information-flow guarantees for agents.

calismalar.baslik: AgentDAM: Privacy Leakage Evaluation for Autonomous Web Agents
calismalar.gerekce: It is an end-to-end benchmark that tests whether web agents follow the data minimization principle.

calismalar.baslik: Imprompter: Tricking LLM Agents into Improper Tool Use
calismalar.gerekce: It uses automatically optimized, obfuscated prompts to exfiltrate PII from production agents through tool calls such as markdown image rendering.

calismalar.baslik: The Emerged Security and Privacy of LLM Agent: A Survey with Case Studies
calismalar.gerekce: It is a core survey that systematizes privacy and security threats to LLM agents and the defenses against them.

calismalar.baslik: IsolateGPT: An Execution Isolation Architecture for LLM-Based Agentic Systems
calismalar.gerekce: It proposes a system architecture that prevents data leakage between third-party apps and tools through execution isolation (NDSS 2025).

calismalar.baslik: System-Level Defense against Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks: An Information Flow Control Perspective
calismalar.gerekce: f-secure is an early system-level defense that formally applies information-flow control to LLM agents.

calismalar.baslik: Design Patterns for Securing LLM Agents against Prompt Injections
calismalar.gerekce: It sets out design patterns that limit agent capabilities so that untrusted input cannot trigger consequential actions or data leakage.

calismalar.baslik: Leaky Thoughts: Large Reasoning Models Are Not Private Thinkers
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that the reasoning traces of reasoning-based agents contain users' sensitive data and are a new leakage surface.

calismalar.baslik: Contextual Integrity in LLMs via Reasoning and Reinforcement Learning
calismalar.gerekce: It uses reinforcement learning to improve contextual integrity reasoning, reducing inappropriate disclosure by agents on PrivacyLens.

calismalar.baslik: Searching for Privacy Risks in LLM Agents via Simulation
calismalar.gerekce: It uses simulation-based search to discover sophisticated multi-turn privacy attacks between agents (impersonation, consent forgery) and the defenses against them.

calismalar.baslik: The Good and The Bad: Exploring Privacy Issues in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that private data in a retrieval database, the foundation of agent memory, can be extracted with black-box queries.

calismalar.baslik: Identifying the Risks of LM Agents with an LM-Emulated Sandbox
calismalar.gerekce: ToolEmu introduced LM-emulated risk evaluation, including privacy breaches, for tool-using agents.

calismalar.baslik: Formalizing and Benchmarking Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses
calismalar.gerekce: It provides a formal framework for prompt injection attacks and a systematic benchmark of defenses (USENIX Security 2024).

calismalar.baslik: Agent Security Bench (ASB): Formalizing and Benchmarking Attacks and Defenses in LLM-based Agents
calismalar.gerekce: It is a broad benchmark that evaluates prompt injection, memory poisoning and backdoor attacks on agents together.

calismalar.baslik: Navigating the Risks: A Survey of Security, Privacy, and Ethics Threats in LLM-Based Agents
calismalar.gerekce: It is a survey that classifies agent privacy leakage by source, covering the LLM controller, multi-source inputs and memory.

calismalar.baslik: MAGPIE: A benchmark for Multi-AGent contextual PrIvacy Evaluation
calismalar.gerekce: It measures contextual privacy leakage in multi-agent collaboration, an important open problem area.

calismalar.baslik: A Survey on Trustworthy LLM Agents: Threats and Countermeasures
calismalar.gerekce: It surveys threats to agent memory and tools and the open problems in memory and agent-to-agent evaluation (KDD 2025).
